reviews.review_title: Great way to see art on your own walls
reviews.review_description:
It does exactly what it says:  you see your own home with passthrough, pick original artwork, and see it hanging on your wall. And if you like the art, you can buy it and hang it up in real life!

I found it easy to place paintings on my walls, and adjust it to exactly where I would want it.

The one real drawback: as I write this, there is a very limited selection of art to choose from (all by the same artist). For a free app that was just released, I'm not going to take off a star for that! From their website, it looks like they are working on finding more artists. It will be nice to see a wide variety of art to choose from.

One thing I would love to see is the option to scan a piece of art using the VR's camera (or perhaps upload a picture or via thumb drive). I'd love to see art I already own on the wall in the place I'm thinking of putting it (and if multiple paintings can be placed at once, I could get a good idea of how well they would fit).
